intro.bodyLine1: This is how Journify handles your data when you visit this site, book a call, or work with us as a client.
intro.bodyLine2: Plain language, not legalese. If anything here is unclear, email jc@journify.ai and we'll explain it.

sections.heading: Who we are
sections.bodyLine1: Journify is an eenmanszaak (sole proprietorship) registered in the Netherlands.
sections.bodyLine5: Registered address: De Quackstraat 54B, 3082VV, Rotterdam, Netherlands

sections.heading: What we collect
sections.bodyLine1: Three categories of data, depending on how you interact with us.
sections.bodyLine2: Site visits. We currently do not run analytics on this site. No cookies are set, no visitor tracking is performed. If this changes, this policy will be updated and a cookie banner added.
sections.bodyLine3: Booking data. When you book a fit call through Cal.com, we receive your name, email address, scheduled time, and anything you type into the booking form. This data lives in Cal.com's systems and is governed by their privacy policy in addition to this one.
sections.bodyLine4: Sales call recordings and transcripts. Fit calls and sales calls are recorded and transcribed. Audio recordings are made via Zoom. Transcripts are generated via Fireflies. Both you and we have access to the recording during the call. The recording, transcript, and any notes taken during the call are stored as part of our sales review process.

sections.heading: Why we collect it
sections.bodyLine1: Booking data is used to schedule and run the call.
sections.bodyLine2: Sales call recordings and transcripts are reviewed by Journify after the call to improve the offer, the positioning, and the sales process. This review is part of the Journify mechanism. It is not shared externally and is not used to train any third-party AI model.
sections.bodyLine3: If you become a client, recordings are also referenced during the engagement to inform the work we do for you.

sections.heading: Where it's stored
sections.bodyLine1: Booking data: Cal.com (United States, operating under EU Standard Contractual Clauses for GDPR compliance).
sections.bodyLine2: Call recordings: Zoom (United States, operating under EU Standard Contractual Clauses for GDPR compliance).
sections.bodyLine3: Transcripts: Fireflies (United States, operating under EU Standard Contractual Clauses for GDPR compliance).
sections.bodyLine4: Notes and analysis: stored in private workspaces accessible only to Journify.

sections.heading: How long we keep it
sections.bodyLine1: If you book a call but do not become a client, we keep the recording, transcript, and related notes for 12 months from the call date, then delete them.
sections.bodyLine2: If you become a client, we keep the recording and transcript for the duration of the engagement plus 24 months for follow-up reference, then delete them.
sections.bodyLine3: Booking data (name, email, scheduled time) is retained until you ask us to delete it or for the same retention windows above, whichever comes first.
sections.bodyLine4: You can request earlier deletion at any time. See your rights below.

sections.heading: Who we share it with
sections.bodyLine1: We use the following sub-processors to operate the service. Each handles only the data described.
sections.bodyLine2: Cal.com — booking management (United States, under EU Standard Contractual Clauses).
sections.bodyLine3: Zoom — video conferencing and call recording (United States, under EU Standard Contractual Clauses).
sections.bodyLine4: Fireflies — call transcription (United States, under EU Standard Contractual Clauses).
sections.bodyLine5: Google — Apps Script and Google Sheets host the shared Journify workspace where saved prospects, messages, and ICP scores are stored (United States, under EU Standard Contractual Clauses).
sections.bodyLine6: Anthropic — AI scoring of prospects, used only if you enable it and only with the API key you provide (United States). Inputs sent to Anthropic's API are not used to train their models.
sections.bodyLine7: We do not sell your data. We do not share it with marketing partners, advertisers, or any third party outside of these named sub-processors, and we do not use it to train any AI model of our own.

sections.heading: Journify ICP Chrome extension
sections.bodyLine1: Journify ICP is a Chrome extension we publish for clients and team members who use it to research, score, and track LinkedIn prospects. If you have not installed the extension, this section does not apply to you.
sections.bodyLine2: Activating the extension, and your access key. You connect the extension once per Chrome profile by entering a personal access code we issue to you. That code is exchanged for a workspace key that identifies you and authorizes the extension to read and write only the Journify account(s) you are assigned to. The key is stored locally on your device, is reusable across sessions, and is never displayed to or shared with other users. The same identity is used when you sign in to the Journify app at app.journify.ai.
sections.bodyLine3: Pages you save. When you actively trigger a save on a profile or company page, the extension reads public profile information (name, headline, current and past roles, education, location, publicly visible posts) or website content (page text and full-page screenshots).
sections.bodyLine4: Your LinkedIn conversations, messages, and reactions. So it can track which prospects replied and booked calls, the extension also reads your LinkedIn messaging — your conversations, the text of the messages within them (both the ones you send and the ones you receive), and reactions — and keeps them synced automatically in the background, roughly every ten minutes, while the extension is connected and message sync is on. This tracking is core to what the extension does: it scores prospects and then measures replies and bookings for them.
sections.bodyLine5: Your LinkedIn session. To read your messages and send replies through LinkedIn's own interface on your behalf, the extension reads your LinkedIn session token (the security cookie LinkedIn issues to your browser). This token is used only to authenticate requests to LinkedIn as you; it is never sent to Journify or stored on our servers.
sections.bodyLine6: Optional ICP scoring via Anthropic. If you enable the ICP scoring feature, the extension sends captured profile information plus your scoring rubric to Anthropic's API using an API key that you provide. Anthropic's privacy policy applies once data reaches their API. Scoring is disabled by default — you choose whether to configure it.
sections.bodyLine7: Where this data goes. Saved pages, conversations, messages, reactions, and the ICP score we generate for a prospect (its verdict, reasoning, and timestamp) are synced to a shared Journify workspace — a Google Sheet (journify-data) that we operate on your behalf, reached through a Google Apps Script endpoint. That Google Sheet is the single source of truth for this data. The people who share your workspace (for example, your account owner and any assistants assigned to your account) can see the synced data, and access is scoped per account: your key only reaches the account(s) you are assigned to.
sections.bodyLine8: Local storage on your device. The extension keeps your configuration (your workspace key, the sync endpoint, and preferences) in chrome.storage.local and a cache of recent rows in IndexedDB so it can show recent work quickly. Both are removed when you uninstall the extension or clear the extension's data from your browser.
sections.bodyLine9: Your consent, and the record of it. Before the extension collects or syncs anything, it shows you this disclosure and requires you to explicitly agree. We record that agreement — who consented, for which account, and the version of this notice — so we can demonstrate consent was given and ask you again if this notice materially changes. Consent is per person and is never inherited from anyone else.
sections.bodyLine10: Your control. You can turn conversation and message sync off at any time from the extension's settings (the Message sync switch), and you can disconnect the extension entirely — turning it off stops any further syncing.
sections.bodyLine11: Retention and your rights. Synced data stays in your Journify workspace until you or your account owner delete it. You can access, export, or delete your data at any time through the app, or by emailing jc@journify.ai. Uninstalling the extension immediately removes all extension-side data (including your access key and the local cache) from your device.

sections.heading: People you research with the extension
sections.bodyLine1: When our clients and team use Journify ICP, the extension processes information about the LinkedIn members they research and contact (prospects). For each prospect this can include their public profile information, their public posts, and — where the operator is connected to them on LinkedIn — the messages exchanged between the operator and that prospect.
sections.bodyLine2: Legal basis. We and our clients process this business-contact information on the basis of legitimate interest in B2B outreach and relationship management, weighed against the rights of the individuals concerned. We do not sell it, we do not share it with advertisers or marketing partners, and we do not use it to train any third-party AI model.
sections.bodyLine3: If you are a prospect and want your data removed. If you believe your information is held in a Journify workspace and you would like it accessed, corrected, or deleted, email jc@journify.ai and we will locate and remove it. The GDPR rights described below apply to you as well.

sections.heading: How we keep it secure
sections.bodyLine1: Access keys. Each person who uses Journify has their own workspace key. We store it only as a one-way hash, never as plain text. Every request carries that key, and our server — not the extension or the app — decides which account the key may read or write. A key cannot reach an account it has not been assigned to.
sections.bodyLine2: Scoped access. Assistants and team members only ever see the accounts they have been assigned to. One client's data is never visible to another client.
sections.bodyLine3: In transit. Data moves over encrypted (HTTPS) connections. Your Anthropic API key, if you provide one, stays on your own device and is sent only to Anthropic when you run a score.

sections.heading: Your rights under GDPR
sections.bodyLine1: As a data subject under EU/EEA law, you have the following rights regarding your data.
sections.bodyLine2: Right of access. You can request a copy of any personal data we hold about you.
sections.bodyLine3: Right to rectification. You can ask us to correct inaccurate data.
sections.bodyLine4: Right to erasure. You can ask us to delete your data, subject to any legal obligations we have to retain it.
sections.bodyLine5: Right to restrict processing. You can ask us to pause processing your data while a request is being handled.
sections.bodyLine6: Right to data portability. You can request your data in a machine-readable format.
sections.bodyLine7: Right to object. You can object to specific processing activities.
sections.bodyLine8: Right to withdraw consent. Where processing is based on consent, you can withdraw it at any time.
sections.bodyLine9: Right to lodge a complaint. You can complain to the Dutch data protection authority, Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens (autoriteitpersoonsgegevens.nl).
sections.bodyLine10: To exercise any of these rights, email jc@journify.ai. We respond within 30 days.

sections.heading: Cookies
sections.bodyLine1: This site does not currently set any cookies.
sections.bodyLine2: If we add analytics in the future, we will update this policy, add a cookie banner, and require consent before any non-essential cookies are set.

sections.heading: Changes to this policy
sections.bodyLine1: If this policy changes, the "last updated" date at the top of the page will reflect the change.
sections.bodyLine2: Material changes will be communicated to active clients directly.
